maria_ng: quick FYI — after last night's kernel-selection tweak, our global 'tokens_saved' went down ~18% during peak. noticed while paging the cost runbook :grimacing:
omar_runtime: ugh. which metric exactly? total token savings from prefix cache or the per-route breakdown?
sasha_obs: saw an alert too — sampling job sent a noise spike. looks like our sampling window missed long-tail customers.
maria_ng: top-level metric was `infra.cache.tokens_saved.v1` (aggregated). drilling into per-customer panels shows a cluster of customers with hit_rate drop from ~62% -> ~42% around 02:10 UTC.
ethan_pm: did the deploy include the new batching heuristic + kernel bias change? could be an interaction where sequences get rekeyed.
liam_perf: I ran a local repro on the same model (redwood-3b-qat) — when kernel-selection prefers kernel B for short prefixes, the prefix key composition differs (we append model_variant tag), so keys don't match previous cache entries.
omar_runtime: ahh that matches: we recently added `variant_id` to the prefix key to avoid collisions across quantized variants. but the rollout should have been backwards-compatible. maybe older cached keys lacked variant and thus missed.
sasha_obs: here's a quick query I used to compare hit rates over time buckets 1m vs 5m. feel free to paste into BigQuery/Grafana datasource:```sql
SELECT
  time_bucket AS ts,
  SUM(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cache_hits), SUM(cache_requests)) AS hit_rate
FROM `redwood-prod.metrics.prefix_cache_v2`
WHERE model = 'redwood-3b-qat' AND time_bucket BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
```
ethan_pm: thanks. can we add an annotation layer in the dashboard that shows deploys and key-schema changes? would make correlation much faster.
maria_ng: yes, please. also proposal: create a short-lived migration job that scans hot prefixes and writes back with the new `variant_id` key so warmup preserves hits during rollout.
liam_perf: I prototyped that — small worker scanning top-10k prefixes per route, rewrite with new key, cost is negligible compared to saved tokens. rough psuedocode:```python
for route in hot_routes:
  for prefix in top_prefixes(route, limit=10000):
    new_key = make_key(prefix, variant_id=current_variant)
    cache.write(new_key, cache.read(old_key(prefix)))
```
omar_runtime: we should gate that to customers with high qps and opt-out for privacy-sensitive customers. also add rate-limit to avoid thundering.
sasha_obs: I'll add a per-customer card to the dashboard: `hit_rate | tokens_saved | pct_of_global_saved` with a small anomaly detector that fires when tokens_saved drops by >10% over baseline for 3 consecutive 5m windows.
maria_ng: alert thresholds sound good. also add a separate alert for 'sampled_metrics_underrepresenting_long_tail' — our existing sampling only keeps 1% of requests and missed these affected customers. increase adaptive sampling to 5% for 30m after deploys.
ethan_pm: deploy-bot noted the kernel-selection rollout at 02:05 UTC — @deploy-bot can you paste the exact rollout id?
deploy-bot: rollout/redwood-kernel-select/2026-02-17-020500 (status: completed) :white_check_mark:
liam_perf: plan: (1) run migration worker for top prefixes in next maintenance window; (2) update dashboard with deploy annotations + per-customer token_savings card; (3) bump sampling to 5% for 30m after major deploys; (4) add unit test to ensure key composition is stable across variants.
omar_runtime: will file a follow-up PR for the key-compat shim so older keys still match if variant_id==default. assigning to @omar_runtime.
maria_ng: thanks team — let's sync tomorrow 10am PST to verify telemetry after the shim. :thumbsup:
